articles.summary: Replenishes common share repurchase authorization to $400.0 million Increases quarterly common share dividend to $0.22 per share Pelagos Insurance Capital Limited (NYSE:PLGO) (“Pelagos Insurance Capital” or the “Company”), an expert capital allocator and risk selector in specialty insurance and reinsurance, announced today an expansion of its capital management initiatives. The Company's Board of Directors has approved the replenishment of its common share repurchase authorization, bringing the total current authorization to $400.0 million, and an increase in the quarterly common share dividend to $0.22 per share. The Board declared the dividend payable on December 23, 2026, to common shareholders of record on December 11, 2026.
